highlights: Save seed from anywhere. The Saved Seeds page now has a "+ Save seed" button at the top that is always there, and the form asks where the seed came from instead of assuming you started on a planting page
Seed that did not come off one of your own plants now has a home — pick the variety and say whether it was a shop, a gift, u-pick or foraged. The Carolina Reaper case
Starting from one of your plants still works exactly as before, and now you can pick the plant from inside the form rather than having to navigate to it first
